mapper.select: SELECT B_IDX,U_NICNAME, B_U_IDX,B_TITLE,B_CONTENT,B_HITS,DATE_FORMAT(B_DATE, '%y-%m-%d') AS B_DATE from BOARD B, USER U WHERE B.B_U_IDX = U.U_IDX

SELECT B_IDX, B_U_IDX, B_TITLE, B_CONTENT, B_HITS, B_DATE, B_MODIFY, B_VOTE, B_DELETE, U_NICNAME, C_NAME FROM BOARD B, USER U, COMPANY C WHERE B.B_U_IDX = U.U_IDX AND U.U_C_IDX = C.C_IDX ORDER BY B_IDX DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT B_IDX, B_U_IDX, B_TITLE, B_CONTENT, B_HITS, B_DATE, B_MODIFY, B_VOTE, B_DELETE,U_NICNAME, C_NAME FROM BOARD B, USER U, COMPANY C WHERE B.B_U_IDX = U.U_IDX AND U.U_C_IDX = C.C_IDX AND B_DELETE = 'N' AND B_IDX < #{lastBIdx} ORDER BY B_IDX DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT B_IDX, B_U_IDX, B_TITLE, B_CONTENT, B_HITS, B_DATE, B_MODIFY, B_VOTE, B_DELETE, U_NICNAME, C_NAME FROM BOARD B, USER U, COMPANY C WHERE B.B_U_IDX = U.U_IDX AND U.U_C_IDX = C.C_IDX AND B_IDX = #{b_idx}
